usage_note: Share of the top 100 Gauntlet (PvP) squads using the savior, snapshot 12 Nov 2026
inv_note: Investment counts key upgrades in the skill data: cooldown cuts and passive unlocks. Low 0-2, Medium 3-4, High 5+.

voyager-stranis.why: The modest PvE and lower PvP ratings fit damage-focused wave utility without immediate team protection or enemy control.
voyager-stranis.prio: Both area skills have cooldown reductions at levels 6 and 10; prioritize whichever is doing the needed job, with Veil Cleave favored for recurring wa…

voyager-smile.why: The better PvE than PvP rating fits gradual Matrix ramp and conditional area follow-ups over longer fights.
voyager-smile.prio: Prioritize ultimate cooldown reductions at levels 6/10 and Cat Tapdance’s Burn chance at levels 6/10 if using the area follow-up.

voyager-oracle.why: The stronger published PvP than PvE rating is consistent with area vulnerability supporting coordinated pressure, rather than a claim that Bind skips enemy turns.
voyager-oracle.prio: Prioritize the ultimate’s level-6 cooldown and level-4/8 Bind chance, then Hecate’s Ember’s level-6/10 cooldowns.

maid-lantern.why: The S PvE / S+ PvP ratings fit strong area pressure plus Buff Block, turn delay and a second damage window after lethal-hit prevention.
maid-lantern.prio: Choose area damage or control as the first job, then buy the matching level-6 cooldown and level-8 utility upgrade.

maid-bell.why: The A PvE / S+ PvP split fits buff stripping and Silence being more influential against opposing teams than many bosses.
maid-bell.prio: Encoffin's cooldown and Silence-chance upgrades are the first control investments, then Condolence's cooldown/chance.

maid-twohander.why: The S+ PvE / S PvP ratings fit broad support plus scaling area damage, especially where repeated incoming attacks shorten her ultimate cooldown.
maid-twohander.prio: Take the two level-6 cooldown upgrades before expensive basic damage; balance Barrier strength against ultimate damage according to role.

kingdom-knight.why: The A PvE / A+ PvP ratings suit a hybrid with an extra-turn buff sequence and ATK Down, rather than a pure damage leader.
kingdom-knight.prio: Choose a role before spending: Vow cooldown and chance upgrades for a buffer, or Unyielding Strike's cooldown followed by damage for a hybrid.

kingdom-shielder.why: The B PvE / C+ PvP ratings fit a straightforward defender with no ordinary heal or Barrier, reliant on susceptible targets for redirection.
kingdom-shielder.prio: Get the party-defense cooldown milestone before damage.

kingdom-pray.why: Her B/B ratings reflect a useful basic sustain package with limited offensive support and a long party cooldown.
kingdom-pray.prio: Spend first on the relevant heal, especially the ultimate's level-6 cooldown, before basic damage.

nightmare-reaper.why: The A+ PvE / S PvP ratings fit strong targeted offensive support and flexible extra-turn sequencing.
nightmare-reaper.prio: Starlit Butterflies' cooldown and ally turn-progress upgrades come first.

stellar-thief.why: The low PvE and modest PvP ratings fit a narrow execute specialist whose best recycling needs kills.
stellar-thief.prio: Continuous Cuts level 6/10 cooldown upgrades reduce punishment when a kill fails.

eastern-swordmaster.why: The stored S+ PvE / S PvP ratings fit wave/focused flexibility, conditional extra turns and meaningful Star support.
eastern-swordmaster.prio: Ordinary attack upgrades are damage nodes rather than listed level-based cooldown reductions.

incognita-landgrave.why: Her value in both modes comes from ally-triggered Burn, turn progress and chain damage against debuffed enemies.
incognita-landgrave.prio: Start with Seething Vengeance's cooldown and Burn-chance milestones, then Nightmare Unleashed's cooldown and ATK investment.

incognita-flower.why: DEF scaling, Guard and self Barriers support a useful conditional protector in either mode.
incognita-flower.prio: Upgrade Thorned Grave's cooldown and Guard duration before basic damage, then Spiked Armor's cooldowns and Barrier.

eastern-owl.why: The stored B PvE / D+ PvP ratings fit useful sustained healing and Sun-team recovery with limited fast defensive control.

apostle-gille.why: The stored PvE NEW / PvP NEW status is provisional.
apostle-gille.prio: Buy the ultimate cooldown milestones before chasing small damage steps.

magician-druid.why: The A/A ratings fit a useful hybrid area attacker and ally buffer rather than a universal top carry.
magician-druid.prio: Prioritize Power of Nature's cooldown, then damage and Rapid Bloom.

saintess-demon.why: The stronger PvE rating fits sustained debuff extension and area pressure when enemies permit useful debuffs.
saintess-demon.prio: Secure Holy Bombardment’s level-6 cooldown and level-8 extension chance when using her as an enabler.

saintess-elf.why: The PvE rating fits targeted recovery and revive insurance but also reflects her lack of party healing and cleanse.
saintess-elf.prio: Targeted-heal cooldown levels 6/10 and ultimate level 6 are sensible milestones.

apostle-tyria.why: The stored S PvE / S+ PvP ratings fit her self-contained marks, conditional DEF penetration and automatic focused finisher, particularly into Defender-class targets.
apostle-tyria.prio: Prioritize level-6 cooldown milestones for both cooldown attacks, then the damage source used most often.

recon-knuckle.why: Both mode ratings fit a strong response to frequent all-target enemy attacks: reaction damage, personal cleanse and turn progress reinforce each other.
recon-knuckle.prio: Fast Track’s level-4/8 gauge upgrades and the ultimate’s level-6 cooldown reduction are practical priorities.

recon-amulet.why: Both mode ratings fit a conditional single-target attacker who needs flower setup, Nova resources and careful own-turn sequencing.
recon-amulet.prio: Prioritize the passive turn-gain levels, then the basic and Winterborne Quartet according to whether damage or debuff reliability is limiting you.

independent-vagabond.why: The A+ PvE / S PvP split fits an evasion-and-counter kit that can punish susceptible opponents but is inconsistent against bosses or accuracy tools.
independent-vagabond.prio: Prioritize the ultimate cooldown and Lunar Shadow's application/damage upgrades.

grace-dualsword.why: The stored B PvE / C PvP ratings fit a functional but self-focused single-target kit with little team utility or enemy denial.
grace-dualsword.prio: Relentless Effort level 6/10 cooldown and level-9 stack reliability are more actionable than inventing a star target.

starpiercer-omega.why: The PvE rating fits repeated-wave payoff after ramping; the much lower PvP rating reflects delayed Power-Up Star conversion and a damage kit without immediate hard contr…
starpiercer-omega.prio: Prioritize Auto-Hunt System’s allied trigger reliability and Mega Punch!’s level-6 cooldown.

bunny-knight.why: The stored S+ PvE / S PvP ratings fit sustained Sun-team damage, party ATK Up, repeated basics and Lucky Token DEF penetration.
bunny-knight.prio: Song of the Toast increases each of its three stack rolls from 75% to 100%; that is a meaningful reliability purchase beyond its level-6 cooldown.

west-beamsword.why: Published PvE A+ and PvP S+ fit a specialist whose buff removal, Stun and turn-progress disruption matter most against enemy teams.
west-beamsword.prio: Secure the control-chance and cooldown upgrades before spending on small basic-damage increases.

west-rod.why: Published PvE A and PvP B+ are plausible for a useful slowing specialist who needs setup and lacks the immediate protection or extra-action damage of stronger general ch…
west-rod.prio: Improve control uptime and application chance before basic damage.

detective-professor.why: The stored S+ PvE / S+ PvP ratings fit a kit that adds allied attacks, damage support, special-skill vulnerability and repeated self turn progress.
detective-professor.prio: The Magic Bullet levels 4/8 improve mark chance and level 6 reduces cooldown.

detective-sheriff.why: The stored S PvE / S+ PvP ratings fit protected focused pressure and repeated special attacks fed by teammates.
detective-sheriff.prio: Prioritize ultimate and special level-6 cooldown milestones, followed by special damage.

wild-hog.why: Published PvE B+ and PvP B+ fit a conditional support defender.
wild-hog.prio: Prioritize cooldown milestones and healthy-team buff chance over damage-only upgrades.

construct-bomb.why: The stored A PvE / A PvP rating fits accessible focused damage plus DEF Down, with speed and conditional turn progress.
construct-bomb.prio: Construction Negotiations levels 4 and 8 increase DEF Down chance, while level 6 reduces cooldown.

bunny-scissors.why: The stored B+ PvE / B+ PvP rating fits useful anti-heal/strip utility with random cooldown acceleration.
bunny-scissors.prio: Prioritize the utility attack used in the encounter before maximizing every damage node.

bunny-spear.why: The stored S PvE / A+ PvP rating fits sustained single-target damage with a crit/Chill loop.
bunny-spear.prio: Prioritize Bunny Jackpot and Where Are You Looking?

summer-oracle.why: The higher PvP rating fits anti-critical support and retaliation against aggressive carries.
summer-oracle.prio: Prioritize the ultimate’s level-6 cooldown, then reaction Taunt chance/damage and passive HP/stack consistency.

summer-smile.why: The better PvE than PvP rating fits sustained marked-target coordination, especially against a durable priority enemy.
summer-smile.prio: Invest Heat Control and the ultimate’s level-6 cooldown before basic damage if using the follow-up engine.

independent-dragon.why: The higher PvE placement fits sustained single-target damage, self-buffs and marked-hit recovery.
independent-dragon.prio: Song of Water and Fire's cooldown and mark-chance upgrades are the practical first milestones, then Upstream Water Prison and passive ATK.

construct-gadget.why: The stored A PvE / B+ PvP rating fits a useful break/crit hybrid whose payoff depends on securing breaks and planning one-turn buffs.
construct-gadget.prio: Buy Chainsaw's cooldown/turn-progress milestones and Bunker's level-6 cooldown before maximizing basics.

detective-watson.why: The stored B PvE / D+ PvP ratings fit conditional area damage and useful ally barriers with slow setup and little immediate denial.
detective-watson.prio: Buy Precious Moment cooldown reductions at levels 6/10 if barriers are why she is selected, then Verdict cooldowns at 6/10.

mutant-mask.why: The A PvE / A+ PvP ratings fit a conditional single-target control attacker.
mutant-mask.prio: Prioritize Distorted Attention's two cooldown milestones, then Price of Silence's cooldown and turn-delay upgrade.

dress-stranis.why: The stored S+ PvE / S PvP ratings fit broad recovery, party cleanse and allied turn progress.
dress-stranis.prio: Prioritize Lumière Sonnet level 6 and Bal Doré recovery upgrades, plus HP.

wedding-shielder.why: The top published rating in both modes fits a broad protection package: damage sharing, automatic rescue, basic-based party healing and targeted full cleanse.
wedding-shielder.prio: Guardian Knight level 6 lowers reaction cooldown and levels 4/8 raise its gauge support.

wedding-dualsword.why: The higher PvP than PvE rating fits an enemy-Barrier counterpick rather than universal damage superiority.
wedding-dualsword.prio: Prioritize Bouquet Toss’s level-6 cooldown and damage, then Bride’s Entrance’s level-6 cooldown and level-4/8 gauge gains.

bunny-pray.why: The stored S PvE / A PvP ratings fit a useful crit-support attacker whose own damage needs High Roller cycling.
bunny-pray.prio: Bullseye level 8 is a concrete stack-reliability milestone; All In level 6/10 improves cadence/reliability.

stranisearl-roseblade.why: The strong PvP rating fits immediate area pressure, extra-turn access and conditional self-cleanse; the PvE rating fits mixed wave and priority-target damage.
stranisearl-roseblade.prio: Upgrade Light-Forged Execution for damage/application and Piercing Star’s level-4/8 gauge gains.

halloween-beamsword.why: Her healing, team ATK buff and conditional repeatable cleanses fit strong support value in both modes.
halloween-beamsword.prio: Start with the two level-6 healing-skill cooldown upgrades, then healing strength and passive HP.

halloween-rod.why: The stronger PvP placement fits linked burst and transformed area attacks when the marked carry can act.
halloween-rod.prio: Prioritize Not My Fault!'s two cooldown upgrades, then area damage and passive levels.

dark-unknown.why: The stored PvE NEW / PvP NEW status is provisional.
dark-unknown.prio: Prioritize the level-6 cooldown milestones and level-8 turn-progress improvements on the two area attacks.

west-lancer.why: Published base ratings of PvE C+ and PvP C are reasonable for a defender whose main support is a short single-target ATK reduction.
west-lancer.prio: Prioritize functional cooldown reductions over damage-only steps.

officer-police.why: The low base-kit ratings fit a narrow self-sustaining role: keeping Annah alive does not protect the rest of the team.
officer-police.prio: Raise Quick Bite Before We Start!

construct-wrench.why: The stored PvE C+ / PvP C ratings fit an ordinary kit with narrow single-target utility, crit conditions and long initial cooldowns.
construct-wrench.prio: Ordinary Nail Drive and Screw Breaker each have cooldown reductions at levels 4 and 8.

lpu-post.why: The C+ PvE / C PvP ratings fit a low-complexity healer with narrow cleansing and uncertain random support.
lpu-post.prio: Invest only far enough to meet the healing requirement if a replacement is planned.

noa-observer.why: The C+ PvE / D+ PvP ratings fit a limited single-target kit with a small debuffed-target bonus and one ordinary control effect.
noa-observer.prio: Take the special's cooldowns if allies establish debuffs; otherwise improve the ultimate's cooldown and chance first.

maid-spear.why: The C+ PvE / C PvP ratings fit a straightforward single-target kit with modest personal tempo and little team utility.
maid-spear.prio: Take Final Service's level-4 cooldown and level-8 turn-progress upgrades, then the special's cooldowns.

maid-scissors.why: The C+ PvE / C PvP ratings fit a narrow Burn specialist with limited utility and a basic HP passive.
maid-scissors.prio: Start with the ultimate's cooldown and meaningful Burn upgrades, then the special's cooldowns.

magician-sniper.why: The C+ PvE / C PvP ratings fit a narrow single-target damage kit whose main utility is SPD Down.
magician-sniper.prio: Prioritize cooldown milestones at levels 4/8 on the skills you use, then damage.

counterside-hilde.why: The stored A PvE / A PvP ratings fit solid self-defense and immediate ally barriers without broad ongoing team sustain.
counterside-hilde.prio: Buy Buster Overdrive level-6 cooldown and level-8 taunt chance, then Dragon Buster level 6.

counterside-mina.why: The stored A PvE / B+ PvP rating fits sustained damage and Bleed across waves with weaker immediate control.
counterside-mina.prio: Prioritize Wolvesbane and Pulse Impact level-6 cooldown/level-8 Bleed reliability.

counterside-rosaria.why: The stored S+ PvE / S+ PvP ratings fit immediate area pressure, area DEF Down, substantial turn progress and a one-time survival safeguard.
counterside-rosaria.prio: Buy Difference in Class levels 4/8 for DEF Down chance and level 6 for cooldown, then Judgement level 6.
